_description: Client-conventions corpus (docs/guides/CLIENT_CONVENTIONS.md): recipient URI (§3), claim URI (§4), identity-key backup mnemonic (§5), fund URI (§8). Append-only, like every corpus in this directory: new vectors may be added, existing vectors are never edited or removed. Every client implementation asserts all sections in CI. The mnemonic section is anchored to the published BIP39 reference test vectors (32-byte entropy rows).

recipient_uri.name: all-zero key (encoding edge, not a real key)
all-ff key (encoding edge, not a real key)

recipient_uri_invalid.name: unknown version byte 0x02 rejected
recipient_uri_invalid.reason: unknown payload version — update your client

claim_uri.name: funded kit: version 2 with a courier seed
funded kit without a secret id

claim_uri_invalid.name: version 2 declaring a funded kit but carrying no seed rejected
claim_uri_invalid.reason: the version byte promised a courier and none arrived — the link is incomplete, and guessing would abandon the funds

claim_uri_invalid.name: bare payload without the claim prefix rejected
claim_uri_invalid.reason: claim URIs must carry the full timeflare:claim/ prefix (private key material is never accepted bare)

claim_uri_invalid.name: unknown version byte 0x03 rejected
claim_uri_invalid.reason: unknown payload version — update your client

claim_uri_invalid.name: version 1 carrying a seed rejected
claim_uri_invalid.reason: a seed on an unseeded version means the link was rewritten in transit

claim_uri_invalid.name: funded kit with an undecodable seed rejected, not degraded
claim_uri_invalid.reason: unlike a stale id, a damaged seed must fail the import rather than silently drop funds

claim_uri_invalid.name: funded kit whose seed carries the identity HRP rejected
claim_uri_invalid.reason: a courier key is tfck; accepting tfsk here would conflate the two key roles
